name: Large Combustion Engine
notes: GT:NH 2.9 structure: 8 long, 3 high, 3 deep, plus the air that must stay in front of the engine intake casings (the front row of the top two layers). Stable Titanium Machine Casings (at least 10) take the maintenance hatch and muffler (left block column and the back top) or input hatches (fuel, lubricant, oxygen: the four casings above and below the gear boxes); the dynamo hatch is on the right end of the gear-box row. Chemically Inert casings form the bottom, PTFE frame boxes the corners. The gear boxes sit on the right of the controller, so two engines are mirror images only when flipped, which GT does not allow (GT:NH issue 24307); side-by-side engines therefore share little.
